title: buglossa sempervirens
intro: Buglossa sempervirens, commonly known as bugloss or snake flower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include soothing inflammation, reducing fever, and acting as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Buglossa sempervirens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents including alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides. However, more research is needed to confirm the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
